quest.title: Wondrous Times
quest.description: Kaveh suggests that you pay a visit to his mother's former professor. Maybe Professor Zaha Hadi will have the clues you seek...

chapter.title: The Pendulum of Weal and Woe

talks.objective: Check out the place Tighnari mentioned
Speak with Zaha Hadi at the nearby place
Wait until after 16:00 the following day

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But don't you love your job, Kaveh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's normal for friends to take care of each other.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But Tighnari saw right through you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's always fun to have you around, Kaveh.

dialogues.speaker: Observe Zaha Hadi
dialogues.text: (Zaha Hadi is still arguing back and forth with Cyrus. It seems that they're not actually angry anymore, but just arguing to pass the time.)

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Stop trying to break down my door, Zaha Hadi! You know I'm not going to come out!
